title: RSV4 Factory 1100 Ultra (Circuit Spec)
description: The Aprilia RSV4 Factory 1100 Ultra (Circuit Spec) delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. A 1100cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
